result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one text collision is clearly visible. Under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time '25–35 min' overlaps the delivery fee '€0 delivery', making both illegible. The clipped carousel item and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time text ('25–35 min') overlaps the '€0 delivery' text on the same line, so both are garbled and unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee on separate lines, or give the metadata row a flex layout with wrapping and proper gaps so the two strings never occupy the same position.
